purpose: Complete the prespecified descriptive calibration program by adding four independently seeded replicates under each of the four frozen event-rate and overdispersion conditions.
reporting_gate: Twenty completed replicates, five per scenario family, with every replicate passing its computational gate authorize descriptive calibration reporting with exact binomial Monte Carlo intervals.
interpretation_boundary: Method-calibration evidence only. Completion authorizes descriptive reporting of bias, RMSE, coverage, and convergence; it does not authorize a claim that nominal 95% coverage has been estimated precisely or any empirical epidemiologic estimate.
